summary.metrics_note: QoS times concern positive-deficit activations; work_makespan includes background work; milliseconds and uncalibrated ticks remain separate; cold_compute_ms is first per-instance call, not process cold start; rollout comparisons use only the predeclared three-seed subset; required_state_objects includes warm and bootstrap dependencies, while required_application_state_objects excludes bootstrap; closure_state_fraction uses the common full-domain application manifest and participating_closure_state_fraction uses only actual write targets; state_bytes/state_objects count actual cold objects and logical payload bytes, not measured serialization

business_metric_definitions.first_activation_ticks: earliest completed activation of a positive priority-weighted deficit flow; not the first scheduled task or first dispatch
business_metric_definitions.qos_all_ticks: latest positive-deficit activation completion, excluding unrelated background work
business_metric_definitions.weighted_t90_ticks: earliest activation completion by which 90 percent of initial priority-weighted positive deficit has recovered
business_metric_definitions.work_makespan_ticks: completion of every scheduled task, including background recovery

protocol.comparison_unit: paired scenario seed, separately by split/profile/flow_count; timing repetitions are not independent experimental units
protocol.compute_unit: measured millisecond; never added to simulation ticks
protocol.performance_claims: Report measured paired effects including regressions; no forced success threshold and no claim of deployed or calibrated recovery latency
protocol.scope: Self-implemented old/new forwarding-rule difference and state/ownership dependency-closure mechanism simulation; not a reproduction of Ares, QUEST, Ravana or a packet/network testbed

state_units.closure_state_fraction: required non-bootstrap application objects divided by a common full-domain target/application manifest
state_units.participating_closure_state_fraction: required non-bootstrap application objects divided by actual write-target application manifest; fully_coupled equals one
state_units.required_state_objects: intrinsic target/state dependency closure including valid warm and bootstrap objects
state_units.state_bytes: actual cold objects' synthetic logical payload bytes, not measured serialization size
state_units.state_objects: actual cold-loaded target/state objects; valid warm snapshots excluded

timing.cold_call_definition: first invocation per instance and policy in an already imported process; not process cold start
timing.policy_order: rotate by seed plus round index

protocol.validity_gate: Every independently audited rule/state/version/owner/activation/forwarding and task resource/dependency violation count is zero; any violation fails the run

summary.scope: Self-implemented old/new forwarding-rule difference and state/ownership dependency-closure mechanism simulation; not a reproduction of Ares, QUEST, Ravana or a packet/network testbed

interpretation.main_result: Reduced build-and-schedule computation and foreground state preparation; little business recovery improvement against the strong independent-object prefetch baseline.
interpretation.time_units: Uncalibrated simulation ticks and measured planner milliseconds are separate. No calibrated end-to-end latency is claimed.
interpretation.workload: Synthetic old/new paths, application dependency manifests and pre-reserved final service, not real WAN traffic or packet/controller execution.
interpretation.method_identity: Self-implemented executable-closure model and scope ablations; not a reproduction of Ares, QUEST, Ravana or ez-Segway.
interpretation.future_state_work: Closure omits unrelated state from the current QoS repair; restoring full programmability later can require that state, so this is not a lifetime transfer saving claim.
interpretation.holdout_integrity: Models, policies and split were frozen before the formal held-out run. Holdout results were not used for retuning.
